arguments.Title: 전경 복귀 후 허브 UI 확인
arguments.Code: using UnityEngine; using InhaExpress.Client.Presentation; internal class CommandScript : IRunCommand { public void Execute(ExecutionResult result) { var h=Object.FindFirstObjectByType<WebClientHud>(); if(h==null){result.Log("NOT_READY");return;} int hubs=0,shown=0; foreach(var t in h.GetComponentsInChildren<RectTransform>(true))if(t.name.StartsWith("Map Pin ")&&!t.name.StartsWith("Map Pin V")){hubs++;if(t.gameObject.activeSelf)shown++;} result.Log("following="+h.OperatorControls.IsFollowing+" hub_pins="+hubs+" shown="+shown); ScreenCapture.CaptureScreenshot("artifacts/high_speed_drive/hub-overview-restored.png"); } }
